etch and sip every 30 minutes.
# dsh-stand-reminder
A DSH desktop widget: a pixel-art worker sits at a desk in the bottom-right corner and nudges you to
stand up and drink water every 30 minutes.
> Repo: <https://github.com/zjhWater/BigWater4Workers> · npm: `dsh-stand-reminder` · 中文说明
When the timer fires, the worker stands up and stretches, a reminder card floats in, and two short c
himes play. "I stood up" restarts the timer; "Remind me in 5 minutes" snoozes it.
The glass on the desk is a separate track: it fills slowly at a "cups per day" pace, and when it's f
ull it's time for a sip. Clicking the glass empties it and starts the next cup. It never interferes
with the stand-up timer.
Everything is a plain in-page timer: no messages are delivered, no agent is woken, no tokens are spe
nt, and nothing goes over the network.
## A day with it
1. Open DSH — the worker sits with his legs on the desk, the monitor is dark with a red power button

, and the badge reads `收工` (off work).
2. Click the monitor to boot: the timer starts and the worker

begins typing. From then on he reminds you to stand up and drink.
3. Need to step away? Click the w
orker — he gets up and walks out of frame, leaving an empty chair. Click the chair when you are back

and he walks back to his seat.
4. Click the monitor again to shut down for the day: the screen show
s the red power button and the worker puts his legs up. Today's counters (worked minutes, cups, glas
s progress) are kept and **reset the next time you boot**, so every day starts clean.
## Reminder rules
| Setting | Default | Notes |

| Interval | 30 min | 5–180 min in the panel |
| Work window | 09:00–18:00 | Outside it the worker s

hows `休息` (rest) and nothing fires |
| Lunch break | 12:00–13:30 | Can be disabled; a reminder due d

uring lunch is postponed until after it |
| Sound | On | Two short tones; browsers mute it until you

interact with the page |
| Volume | 70% | 0–100%, slider in the panel; saved live, plays a sample o

n release |
| Widget size | 100% | Base = `clamp(160px, min(viewport width, height) × 26%, 320px)`,
so it scales with the window (same idea as the whale widget). The slider/wheel multiplies that by 50

%–300% and only scales the pixel scene — badge, card and panel keep their font sizes |
| Clock size

| 32px | 20–48px, badge only; the panel follows the Harness UI font |
| Water reminder | On | Panel
shows "drank X / goal N cups", default 8. The glass fills about every 56 minutes (effective work min
utes ÷ goal). It fills whenever you are at the computer, work window or not. Based on the 2022 Chine

se Dietary Guidelines (1700 ml/day for men, 1500 ml/day for women) |
| Work log | Shown | Hides the
"worked today" row; the duration accumulates from boot time |
## Interactions
| Where | What it does |
| Monitor | Boot / shut down. Shutting down means off work: red power button on the screen, legs up.

Click again to boot |
| Worker | Leave the desk (walks out of frame, empty chair stays) |
| Chair |

Come back (walks in and restarts the timer) |
| Glass on the desk | Counts as one cup: level resets

to zero, today's count +1, starts filling again |
| Three-line button (on hover) | Opens the settin

gs panel (same style as the whale widget) |
| Drag the worker | Move it; snaps within 10% of the lef

t/right edge and 15% of the bottom, and mirrors horizontally when snapped left |
| Hover + wheel | Z

5% of the bottom, and mirrors horizontally when snapped left |
| Hover + wheel | Zoom 5% per notch |
Language: the UI follows the DSH/browser language by default (`zh*` → Chinese, anything else → Engli
sh). The first row of the settings panel has a **Language** switch — follow system / 中文 / English —
and the choice is stored with the rest of the settings.
Reminder card buttons: `我站起来了` (I stood up — restart the timer), `再过 5 分钟` (in 5 minutes), `不再提醒` (n
ot today). `Esc` closes the card or the panel.
Edge behaviour:
- The card hides itself after 60 seconds and the worker sits back down; if nobody reacts, it retries

once after 10 minutes, then returns to the normal interval.
- Nothing fires in the last 10 minutes

of the work window, so you are not told to stand up right before going home.
- If the machine slept
or the page was closed long enough to miss more than 5 minutes, it does not replay the reminder — it

quietly shifts forward.
- `不再提醒` pauses until the next working day at 09:00.
- The first open of a

new day always starts at `未开机` (not booted), with the glass and work log cleared.
- State is synced
across tabs through `localStorage` events.
## Mini mode
Clicking the `—` button turns the whole widget into a row of cups at the bottom of the composer:

- One cup per daily goal (8 by default).
- Grey = not reached yet; blue water rising from the bottom

= the current cup filling.
- A full cup grows from 1× to 2× over 5 minutes, breathes gently and pla

ys a chime.
- Click a cup to drink: the water clears, the cup shrinks back and fades out, and the ne

xt one starts filling.
- Hover the row and two small buttons appear on the right: settings and `+` (

back to the full widget).
- Drag the row anywhere (gaps included) to move it; double-click to snap i
t back under the composer.
Stand-up reminders are disabled in mini mode — only the water track stays. The row sticks to the com
poser while the window resizes or the page scrolls. The settings and `+` buttons only appear on hove
r, so they don't add clutter.
## Data
One `localStorage` entry (`dsh-stand-reminder:v1`) plus one JSON file on the host side (`~/.dsh/dsh-
stand-reminder.json`, read and written through the plugin's own `/dsh-stand-reminder/state` route).
The host copy exists because DSH changes its port on every launch and `localStorage` is per-origin,
so `localStorage` alone would give you an empty profile — and a default position — every time.
Stored: settings, next reminder time, pause deadline, powered/away state, water progress and worked
time, widget and cup-row positions. Local only, never uploaded.
## Install
From npm (recommended): search for `dsh-stand-reminder` on the DSH plugin page, or let `plugin_manag
er` in a session install it:
